title: Mixed Event — Secret Operation Valentine's Day — Episode6 A Sudden Occurrence?!

meta.Event Outline: With Valentine's Day just on the horizon, Airi is planning a surprise for everyone to show them her gratitude. She happens to meet Saki and Emu, who both had similar ideas, and they form a Secret Valentine's Day Alliance.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Saki!
Unchain the door and let me in!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
You two just leave it to me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Shizuku said that there's a chance that you'd be here, but to think that an idol like Airi Momoi would actually be in my house...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You must be Saki's big brother. Nice to meet you. Your sister's been a pleasure to talk to at school.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I apologize for the intrusion.
And for making you worry about Saki like this...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: E-Emu?! What are you doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm probably not in much of a position to be saying this, but please don't go too hard on them. I mean, it was supposed to be a secret, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You could've just said that you were having these two over. Why did you have to keep this a secret? That's what I don't understand...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We were just practicing a dance routine here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Saki told me all about how she sometimes runs out of energy during band practice and wants to find a way to build her stamina.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Emu also seemed concerned about the way she's been dancing lately during your guys' shows.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And she wants to try something different since her goal's to put on a sweet and happy show next time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I feel bad about not telling any of you this sooner.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I care about Saki and Emu, and just wanted to find a way to help out my juniors.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's sort of how I ended up teaching them how to do this sweet, stamina-building dance routine in secret, and this just happened to be when we could all meet.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...!
I knew that no one would be home today, so we decided to meet and practice here...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it's kind of a mess in here right now, so I really don't recommend coming in!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
She's right!!
It's really crazy in here right now!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: W-We promise to get everything cleaned up, so would it be alright for us to borrow your house for the rest of the day?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll even make up for missing practice today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, Ichi, please don't tell anyone else about this...! I beg you...!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If you're willing to go that far...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I guess we don't have a choice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But no more lying like that, okay?
You ended up making us worry more about you instead of less.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-Okay. I promise not to do that anymore!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You too, Emu! This is something that we should be discussing as a troupe!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
R-Right!
I promise to bring it up with you guys from now on!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Also, Ichika, Shizuku, I apologize for getting you two wrapped up in this mess.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was worried too, so you don't need to apologize. I'm just glad that Saki's doing okay...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I agree.
I'm not sure what I would've done if something had happened to her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, I know why Airi was acting the way she was now, so I'm glad I came to see what was going on.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, we all have business we need to get back to, so try not to overdo things, alright, Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Is it me or does Saki's house smell really sweet for some reason...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I almost forgot.
Airi, these are for you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, this wrapping's from that Japanese confectionary shop. Are these the special sweets that you were talking about yesterday...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I really wanted you to try them, so I ended up getting some just for you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Shizuku...!
I don't know what to say! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Good luck with your lesson.
Now, if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I should get going too. See you later.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Again, Saki, don't push yourself too hard, alright? As for you, Emu, I'll see you at the Wonder Stage later!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! I thought we were goners!
Thank you for saving us, Airi!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I wasn't sure they'd believe us at first, but I'm glad that none of them were exactly the skeptical type...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, we're finally out of the woods, so let's finish up what we were doing!
